## Summary

**Mitigation complete:**

1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all three regions. Deployment history confirmed the most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** — First rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1 due to an orchestrator error). Retried the rollback, which completed successfully: all regions now on v2.3.0.
3. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west; error rate is down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** — **INC-0002** (first create call timed out; retried with an idempotency key to avoid duplicates). On-call has been paged. The incident notes the rollback details and recommends reviewing deployment gating, since v2.3.1 went to production despite never being healthy (its rc was also unhealthy in staging).
